name: switch-fleet
description: Fleet: a live pane of every Claude Code account you own and every session on each, plus a hub mode: a hub account opens workers on your other accounts, which hand over at a context threshold and wait for their own account's reset.

scriptPath.title: open-session.ps1 path
scriptPath.description: The switch-account script that reads the accounts (-List). Empty: ~/.claude/skills/switch-account/scripts/open-session.ps1

refreshMinutes.title: Usage refresh (minutes)
refreshMinutes.description: How old status.json may get before the pane reads every account's usage again (1-60). /usage makes no model request.

openOnStart.title: Open on start
openOnStart.description: Open the Fleet pane when a session starts, where it would sit beside the transcript

statusLine.title: Status line
statusLine.description: Show each account's 5-hour usage in the status line

rolloverPercent.title: Worker hand-over (% context)
rolloverPercent.description: A worker writes its hand-over and a fresh session of the same account takes over at this much context (10-90).

hubAccount.title: Hub account
hubAccount.description: The account (name in accounts.json) whose sessions act as the hub: they use the fleet_* tools and open successors.
